## Procedure

1. Maintain a constant body position and raise dumbbells directly to the front until they are at shoulder level (-18)
2. Keep palms facing the ground and lower dumbbells slowly, back to the start position

## Coaching Points

- Maintain a constant head, body, and arm position throughout the entire lift
- Avoid using momentum to complete the lift

## Lateral Raises

Exercise Objective: Isolate and develop strength in the lateral deltoids
